independence_declaration.statement: I (domain-reviewer) authored no implementation in the DG1 candidate. backend-workflow-engineer wrote the round-14 repair for F-DG1-135 (T-DG1-BE15, commit fbc9ba6). code-security-reviewer raised F-DG1-135 in round 13; I did not. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-14 record, and I read none of them. The only earlier-round records I read were my own role's round-13 record and scripts, to reuse its procedures, plus the F-DG1-135 entry in findings.json.

checks_run.actual: HEAD is 6a3e3b2d663a…, not shallow. Both computations give sha256:dd747fe1df62d876a74101caa826542b90d3eb36cedb1de14f299b0b6de8c559 with 391 files. 985d0fa..HEAD touches only the round-14 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json, all of them excluded from the candidate. checks_run.procedure: Check that the new TEST_FILE equals the build exclusion and covers what vitest collects. Read tsconfig.build.json and the vitest include. Inventory the real module tree by extension. Find every test-like file under apps/api/src that is not .test.ts or .test.tsx. Read the TEST_FILE, CODE_FILE and isTest uses.
checks_run.command: cat apps/api/tsconfig.build.json; grep -nE 'include|test\.' vitest.config.ts; find apps/api/src/modules -type f | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort | uniq -c; find apps/api/src/modules -name '*.test.*'; find apps/api/src -name '*.test.*' ! -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.test.tsx'; grep -nE 'TEST_FILE|isTest|CODE_FILE|TEST_SUPPORT' apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts
checks_run.expected: The build excludes src/**/*.test.ts, src/**/*.test.tsx and *.testkit.ts. TEST_FILE is /\.test\.tsx?$/ and is used only for isTest. walk() still uses the broad CODE_FILE. Every real module test file is .test.ts. No other test-like file exists.
checks_run.actual: tsconfig.build.json excludes [src/**/*.test.ts, src/**/*.test.tsx, src/**/*.testkit.ts]. The vitest unit-node include is apps/api/src/**/*.test.ts. The module tree holds 41 files, all .ts, and its 7 test files are all .test.ts. No .test.<other ext> file exists in apps/api/src. TEST_FILE = /\.test\.tsx?$/ (line 183) is used only at line 467, isTest, which gates the TEST_SUPPORT_FILES (line 477) and vitest (line 486) allowances. walk() uses CODE_FILE (line 191). One observation, not a defect: .test.tsx keeps the allowance although vitest collects only .test.ts. Such a file is excluded from the build, so it never ships. The finding's own 'expected' calls that case harmless.

checks_run.expected: All integration tests pass on both Node versions: G6 closure refused with 422 invalid-transition, record unchanged; cross-scope reads and writes denied (404/403); revocation takes effect; OIDC and identity routes; cursor pagination binding and tamper refusal. No leftover databases. Any pg.log FATAL is unrelated to the product.

Run 3 had 0 FATAL. Run 4 had 1 FATAL, 'FATAL: the database system is starting up', which is the script's own psql readiness poll hitting the cluster while it starts. The suites include 'closure is not a status edit (F-DG1-001…)' (3 cases), the access-scope and A12 cross-scope suites, the F-DG1-106 creator assignment, the OIDC callback/login CSRF/logout cases, and 'list: filters, sorting and cursor pagination' (3 cases).

summary: PASS. The F-DG1-135 fix verifies. TEST_FILE = /\.test\.tsx?$/ exactly matches the build exclusion. On disk, a planted *.test.<mts|js|cts|mjs|cjs|jsx> that imports vitest or ../../modules.ts is now flagged. The .test.ts twin is not, and the round-13 testkit misses all six, which confirms the original gap and that the probe discriminates. The verdict on the real tree is unchanged: 13 modules with [] violations, 7 real .test.ts files that keep their vitest allowance, and architecture 128/128 on Node 22 and 24. No product, contract, data-model, i18n or source file changed. Unit 321/321 on both Nodes; integration 200/200 in 4 runs (Node 22 and 24); live AR-RTL/EN-LTR shell 108/108 with the G6 closure 422, scoped access, identity and cursor pagination intact. All invariants hold. The register is unchanged and complete. No open Critical/High/mandatory finding. No new findings.
